ledger_entry_correction_role_check.name: ledger_entry_correction_role_check
ledger_entry_correction_role_check.value: "fintrack"."ledger_entry"."correction_role" is null or ("fintrack"."ledger_entry"."correction_role" in ('REVERSAL', 'REPLACEMENT') and "fintrack"."ledger_entry"."corrects_entry_id" is not null)

monthly_income_rule_last_cycle_check.name: monthly_income_rule_last_cycle_check
monthly_income_rule_last_cycle_check.value: last_expected_cycle is null or (last_expected_cycle ~ '^[0-9]{4}-(0[1-9]|1[0-2])$' and last_expected_cycle >= first_expected_cycle)

onboarding_snapshot_confirmed_fields_che.name: onboarding_snapshot_confirmed_fields_check
onboarding_snapshot_confirmed_fields_che.value: "fintrack"."onboarding_snapshot"."status" = 'DRAFT' or ("fintrack"."onboarding_snapshot"."cutover_at" is not null and "fintrack"."onboarding_snapshot"."confirmed_at" is not null)

recurring_expense_rule_last_cycle_check.name: recurring_expense_rule_last_cycle_check
recurring_expense_rule_last_cycle_check.value: last_cycle is null or (last_cycle ~ '^[0-9]{4}-(0[1-9]|1[0-2])$' and last_cycle >= first_cycle)

settlement_settled_fields_check.name: settlement_settled_fields_check
settlement_settled_fields_check.value: "fintrack"."settlement"."status" = 'DRAFT' or ("fintrack"."settlement"."closing_confirmation_id" is not null and "fintrack"."settlement"."living_expense_minor" is not null and "fintrack"."settlement"."snapshot" is not null and "fintrack"."settlement"."settled_at" is not null)

transfer_target_version_retirement_check.name: transfer_target_version_retirement_check
transfer_target_version_retirement_check.value: ("fintrack"."transfer_target_version"."is_actionable" and "fintrack"."transfer_target_version"."retirement_reason" is null) or (not "fintrack"."transfer_target_version"."is_actionable" and "fintrack"."transfer_target_version"."retirement_reason" in ('INCOME_NOT_RECEIVED', 'LIQUIDITY_WRITE_OFF'))
